We’ll accept nothing short of a 5* home for this exceptional soul. She is able to live with other dogs and children. She has been in contact with cats in foster care but we would prefer for her to go to a cat-free home for safety reasons due to her size.

If you think you might be able to offer our amazing Tally a lifetime of love and all the attention in the world, please do get in touch.

name: Woody
description:
Woody is a 8 year old male Dalmatian. He’s a large, spot-covered lad who brings a whole lot of love everywhere he goes.

His gentle temperament and sweet nature make him the kind of dog who stands out without even trying.

Woody has a loyal streak and thrives when he’s close to his humans. He’s brilliant with adults and can live with older children, happily soaking up attention and affection. Fully vaccinated and neutered, he’s physically ready for his next chapter.

Woody does have some lead reactivity towards other dogs, but adopters will receive full support and guidance to help him feel more confident.

As he can’t live with cats and must be the only dog, he’ll suit a calm home where he can relax without competition. What he truly wants is a comfy sofa and a family who sees just how special he is.

Woody would bring warmth, steadiness and pure devotion to any home lucky enough to have him. He’s affectionate, kind-hearted and ready for a peaceful life where he can finally unwind and enjoy the comfort he deserves.

name: Nessa
description:
Nessa is a beautiful 2-year-old Mastiff Cross.

Nessa is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Nessa is very friendly & affectionate, but can be initially wary when meeting new people. She can easily be won round in no time, with a treat or her favourite toy – a tennis ball!

She is a right water baby and loves to dip her toes into an puddle, stream or river!

Nessa is truly a lovely girl with sooo much potential to be an amazing dog, she’s been living a kennel life since she was 8 months old so really deserves a chance at a forever home where she can really thrive

Nessa is strong on the lead and will certainly need more training in this area, as well as with some basic manners (she will jump up uninvited sometimes).

She does however listen to correction well and is very treat/tennis ball driven, so this will help keep her focus to help when she’s on the lead and other areas of her training

We’ve found Nessa to be hit & miss with other dogs, it’s clear she hasn’t had much socialisation around them, so until this has improved she will do best in a pet free home so the focus can solely be on Nessa and training her up to be the best dog!

She will happily walk alongside another dog and doesn’t react, she just doesn’t want to live with one.

Anyone interested in meeting one of the funniest & quirkiest dogs around please get in touch.

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Sallie
description:
Meet Sallie, the sweet little whirlwind with a huge heart.

Sallie – 11 month old female Cross-Breed.

Sallie is currently in foster in Coventry. She is a bright, loving young pup who is looking for a home that can give her the time, routine, and understanding she needs to grow into the wonderful dog she has the potential to be.

She recently flew from Cyprus to her foster home and currently weighs around nineteen kilograms, expected to reach approximately twenty-three to twenty-five kilograms once fully grown.

Sallie is a joyful mix of affection, cheekiness, and curiosity. Once she feels settled and knows her people, she becomes incredibly loving.

She adores cuddling up on the sofa for her quiet moments and is very good at taking herself off to a peaceful corner when she wants a bit of downtime; her crate or the kitchen tub chairs are particular favourites.

• A happy, lively pup who loves to play and explore.• Cheeky, full of life, and wonderfully inquisitive.• Enjoys her independence and will happily potter off for her own space.• Obsessed with stuffed toys—the noisier the better.

Sallie is at that puppy stage where everything is new and exciting, and she’s eager to learn. She watches everything you do, takes direction well, and already knows sit and wait.

She thrives with enrichment like stuffed Kongs, Licki mats, and snuffle mats—these help her self-soothe and learn calm behaviours.

• Lead walking: Good on the lead, though she doesn’t like feeling restricted and may try to chew what’s near her. Road walking is still being introduced as she can be nervous.• Food manners: Excellent with humans—takes treats gently. She is currently fed separately from the resident dog as she settles into household routines.• Other dogs: Friendly but a little overenthusiastic in greetings.• People & children: Not kid-tested. Can be vocal with visitors and needs reassurance and guidance. Would be best suited to older, dog-savvy kids.• Cats/small furries: Not tested, likely too exciting for her at this stage.• Crate: Doing well with crate training.

• A calm, experienced home ready for the excitement and fun of a young pup.• Someone able to offer structure, patience, routine, and ongoing training.• Potentially a calm male dog who would enjoy playing with her or a family able to spend time helping her settle.• A home ready for a puppy.

She is a truly lovely girl who just needs the right environment to blossom. With consistency, reassurance, and understanding, Sallie has all the makings of a loyal, cuddly, playful, and wonderfully spirited companion.

If you think you could be the one to help this sweet pup grow into her best self, Sallie would love to meet you.

Please tell us a little about yourself when contacting us:

Your garden and fencing (height at lowest point)

Ages of children in the home or who visit

How long Sallie may be left alone, and how she’ll fit into your lifestyle

Sallie is spayed, vaccinated, and microchipped. A minimum adoption donation of £300 applies. Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application, home check, neutering agreement at her adopter’s expense when she reaches the appropriate age as agreed with your vet, and agreement to our adoption conditions.

We are committed to the lifelong care of our dogs and will always accept their return when space allows. In situations where space is limited, we will endeavour to rehome the dog directly from its current home.

Under no circumstances may the dog be transferred to another UK rescue organisation.

name: Casper
description:
Meet Casper, a 5 year old male Cross-Breed who’s been waiting far too long for his shot at happiness. He’s currently based at Simba Shelter in Cyprus and has sadly become one of their longest residents.

Well over a year he has been in the shelter and you can actually see the sadness in his eyes.

How can a dog that looks like Casper have been in the shelter for all this time. Is it his age? The fact that he’s not small and fluffy? He deserves a second chance in life just as much as the desirable-looking dogs.

And the most heartbreaking thing is his affinity for humans. He doesn’t get out of his kennel much but, when he does, he relishes at the opportunity for some human affection.

In his current situation, he shows less interest in his actual walks and more interest in humans.

Casper is a profoundly wonderful dog on so many levels. Not only is he incredibly handsome, but he’s also clever and eager to please. He would suit an adopter willing to take the time to get to know him, train him, and invest in his potential.

Casper has shared his space with female dogs but has shown to be generally quite selective with canines. As a result, he requires a pet/dog-free home.

As with any rescue dog, Casper needs time and structure to settle into home life. In return, Casper will give back tenfold — loyalty, love, and gratitude in abundance.

Having known hardship and the loss of a family (we think he had a home before), Casper will be one of those eternally grateful dogs.

They are simply a joy to take under your wing and watch thrive in a home. And we, as volunteers, love to see this. It is exactly why we volunteer in dog rescue, to see dogs like Casper come out the other side and get their happy ending.

We provide full rescue back up and provide guidance and support throughout a dogs life.

Casper’s adoption fee is sponsored due to the length of time he has been in the shelter.

Casper is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and be tested for infectious diseases. He is fully vaccinated and castrated.

Foster placement, foster view to adopt, and adoption all considered.

name: Orion
description:
Orion is a 1 year old, medium-large, male, Cross-Breed, who is a sweet, friendly, lovely boy waiting for his forever home. He has never truly known what it means to be a carefree puppy.

He should be enjoying life in a loving home, cared for and cherished, warm at night instead of sleeping on a concrete floor.

Confiscated from his owners, Orion and his three siblings have all been in the shelter since they were just young pups. Arguably, it was the best thing to happen to them, but now they each really need a home and family to call their own.

Orion is a medium-large dog who will need ongoing training to help him settle into home life. He has gotten used to walking on a lead and is well behaved on walks.

He is also wonderful with other dogs and children. Even though he is young, Orion and all of his siblings give off a lovely calming energy and we suspect they will be medium energy once in a home.

Orion is far too young to spend his days in a shelter and has missed an important stage of learning and exploring, but it’s never too late for dogs! He could live with a single person, a couple, or a family. A secure garden and nice walks would be ideal.

Orion can be adopted in Cyprus or the UK. He will be tested for infectious diseases, is castrated, will travel with a passport, be vaccinated, including rabies, and receive regular flea and worm treatments.

Please help give this lovely boy the life he deserves.

Full rescue back-up is provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue, a UK-based registered charity.

Foster placement, foster view to adopt, and adoption all considered.

name: Danny
description:
Danny is a beautiful and handsome, young Collie/Pointer cross Mastin boy, with a short, black and white flecked coat. Poor boy has had a terrible experience of life so far, but now things are turning around for him.

Danny is very sweet natured, with a big heart and lots of trust and affection to humans being kind to him.

Danny started life scavenging for scraps, terrified of people. A kind volunteer began leaving out food for him and he would eat it and even play with her dogs, but he would bolt the second she got close.

When a cruel neighbour started throwing stones at him and threatening his life, she knew she had to save him from that place and move him urgently.

When he arrived in foster care, Danny was a different kind of broken — frozen with fear, hiding in corners, too scared even to be moved. But with his foster housemates by his side, Danny slowly started to come back to life.

Fast forward a few weeks, and this boy is unrecognisable. He is now playful, affectionate, cheerful, and SO ready to give and receive love.

He’s still a little shy in new places and with loud noises which is understandable but he’s intelligent, eager to learn, and already walking beautifully on the lead, trotting alongside a bike, and settling nicely in the car.

Danny loves his doggy friends but has not yet been tested with cats.

Danny didn’t have an easy start, but he never stopped trusting that good things were possible. Now he just needs someone to give him the home he’s been waiting for. And needs someone with time and patience to let him blossom.

Danny is neutered, up to date with vaccinations and had clear blood tests, and tested negative for Brucella

We are looking for a family with another friendly dog for Danny to play with and learn from, and older calm children no younger than 11yrs to suit his level of confidence.

Good on lead, good with bikes, good in the car Good other dogs and people. Smart, affectionate, and blossoming every day.

name: Bianca
description:
Bianca is a 3-year-old female Husky-Cross. This medium-large girl, weighing approximately 25kg, has already been through more than most dogs should ever have to.

Found starving and alone on the streets of Cyprus, she was so desperate for food that she was eating scraps alongside a colony of cats.

Emaciated, weak, and suffering from leishmania, she had clearly been abandoned once her illness made her “inconvenient.”

But despite the pain and neglect she endured, Bianca never gave up. She quietly accepted her rescue, knowing on some deep level that things were about to change.

Thanks to an incredible foster family, Bianca has transformed. With love, vet care, and proper medication, she has overcome her leishmania — now fully recovered and thriving.

She just needs a simple tablet twice a day to keep the condition in check. It’s manageable, doesn’t increase insurance premiums or affect her quality of life, and is absolutely worth it for a dog who gives love as fiercely as Bianca does.

For the past1 year, Bianca has been living in a foster home and learning how to be a dog again. She’s fully house trained, understands basic commands, and walks well on the leash.

She’s food motivated, making her very trainable — and she’s totally obsessed with squeaky balls. Her ideal day? A long sniffy walk, a fun play session, and cuddles with her favourite humans.

Bianca is incredibly affectionate and loyal to her circle, though she can take a little time to warm up to strangers. Once you’re in her heart though, you’re there for life.

She’s not keen on other animals and must be the only pet in the home. That said, she’s all the dog you’ll ever need — her love runs deep.

Her perfect match would be someone who loves big, bold personalities with even bigger hearts. An active home is ideal, with people who appreciate her breed’s intelligence and energy.

While experience with dogs — especially Huskies — is helpful, it’s not a strict requirement. What matters most is a loving, understanding home that’s ready to give this beautiful girl the second chance she’s waited so long for.

Bianca can be adopted in Cyprus or the UK. She has been tested for other infectious diseases, is spayed, will travel with a passport, be vaccinated, including rabies, and receive regular flea and worm treatments.

Foster placement, foster view to adopt, and adoption all considered.

name: Hermes
description:
Hermes is a 1.5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a sweet, gentle and friendly young dog who is looking for his forever home. He gets along beautifully with everyone he meets and has a lovely nature.

Hermes enjoys being around people and makes a wonderful companion. His friendly personality means he is happy to spend time with those around him. He is also social with other dogs and is suitable to live with them.

Hermes has not yet been tested with cats, so it is not known whether he could live with them. He is suitable to live with older children, making him a good match for families with sensible older youngsters.

He is looking for a loving home where he can continue to thrive.

Hermes is currently based in Cyprus but is able to travel to the UK or anywhere in Europe once he has been adopted. He is ready to make the journey to begin a new life with his forever family.

He is hoping to find a home where he will be loved and cared for.

Hermes will be rehomed with a full adoption package. His vaccinations are up to date, and he is microchipped, blood tested and neutered.

Full rescue backup will be provided, and a home check is required before his adoption can be completed.

name: Roy
description:
Roy is a 1.5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is an amazing, happy and friendly boy who is looking for his forever home. With his cheerful personality and beautiful smile, Roy is hoping to find a family who will love him for the rest of his life.

Roy is very friendly with people and enjoys spending time with them. He also gets on well with other dogs and is suitable to live in a home with canine companions. His happy nature makes him a wonderful companion.

Roy has not yet been tested with cats, so it is not known whether he could live with them. He is suitable to live with older children, making him a good match for families with sensible older youngsters.

He is looking for a home where he can continue to be happy and loved.

Roy is currently based in Cyprus but can travel to the UK or elsewhere in Europe once he has been adopted. He is ready to make the journey to his forever family when the right home comes along.

He is waiting for someone to give him the chance he deserves.

Roy will be adopted with a full adoption package. This includes vaccinations, a microchip, blood tests and neutering before he joins his new home. Rescue backup and support will be provided, and a home check applies as part of the adoption process.

name: Newton
description:
Newton, approximately 4 yrs old, large, crossbreed.

Newton can only be described as a cuddly bear! He loves people, adores attention, and thinks he’s still a pup. Despite his size he will try to climb on your lap for cuddles.

Newton is a stunning boy with the softest coat and the most loving nature. He’s incredibly cuddly, adores human interaction, and will happily lean in for a good neck scratch and cuddle any chance he gets.

His affectionate personality makes him a truly special companion and it is a testament to him, given the situation he has found himself in.

Newton has been with shelter for a while and, sadly, no one ever came forward to claim him. Given his loving and gentle nature, we think he had a home before and had humans that he loved, even if this wasn’t reciprocated.

Despite this, he remains full of love and is quite happy-go-lucky.

He is a strong boy, so he will thrive in a home with experienced owners. He walks nicely on the leash. Newton gets along well with female dogs of a similar size but can’t live with males or smaller dogs.

He’s not just looking for a home—he’s looking for someone who understands him, can guide him, and will give him the love and structure he needs to truly flourish.

In return, you’ll gain a loyal, affectionate companion who will be by your side through everything. He would suit an active family (children 10+ due to size), single person, or a couple.

Newton can be adopted in the UK or Cyprus. His adoption fees are sponsored so, if travelling to the UK, we are just asking for travel costs to be covered.

He is ready to fly. He is vaccinated, castrated, and has had a full health check and blood tests for infectious diseases.

Foster placement, foster view to adopt, and adoption all considered.

name: Max
description:
A strikingly handsome, loyal, intelligent boy who is ready for his new life.

Max is the kind of dog who makes an impression the moment you meet him — confident, affectionate, and beautifully connected to his people. At 30 kg, he’s a solid lad with a gentle heart and a playful spirit.

Great with other dogs — social, friendly, easy-going

Very loyal and smart — bonds deeply, learns quickly

Loves being brushed, fussed, and played with

Excellent at the vets, calm and cooperative

Plays happily with our 14?year?old work experience student

Has interacted with small dogs and younger children with no issues

Car rides aren’t his favourite yet — most likely because he was abandoned and fears it may happen again. But he’s improving every week, learning that car trips now mean safety, not abandonment.

And truly… he has the best set of pearly white teeth we’ve ever seen.

Max is an all?around super boy who will thrive with:

An active family, Someone home often, Children 10+ due to his size – A home that values companionship, routine, and fun

Max is fully vaccinated, neutered, and ready to fly on August 2nd. For everyone’s comfort and safety, children in the household must be 10+ due to his size.

name: Sadie
description:
SADIE – FOUR YEARS OF LOVE, STILL WAITING FOR HER PERSON

Four years. That’s how long Sadie has been waiting. Four years of wagging her tail for every visitor, hoping today might be her day.

Four years of pressing her head into the hands of rescuers, desperate to be someone’s dog. Four years of watching others leave while she stayed behind.

Sadie is love in its purest form. She is human-oriented in every way, craving touch, affection, and closeness. She is cuddly beyond words, the kind of dog who melts into your arms.

She is loyal and devoted, ready to give her whole heart to the person who finally chooses her. But Sadie has never been chosen. She doesn’t understand why.

She doesn’t know that dogs like her—dogs who don’t like sharing their humans—often wait the longest. Because Sadie isn’t just loyal—she is fiercely devoted.

She doesn’t just want love—she wants to protect it. She doesn’t want to share her human—she wants to belong to them, and only them.

Sadie is not a dog for just any home. She is a dog for someone who wants an unbreakable bond. Someone who will be her world, just as she will be theirs.

At 6 years old, Sadie is still waiting. She is not meant to be one of many. She is meant to be someone’s one and only. Sadie needs to be the only dog in the home.

She will love her person beyond measure—and fiercely protect them from every other dog. She is waiting for the human who needs her as much as she needs them. Could that person be you?

6 years old (March 2025) – four years of waiting for her chanceMiddle-sized, stunning, and full of loveDeeply affectionate, cuddly, and human-orientedLoyal beyond words—ready to give her whole heartNeeds to be the only dog in the homeWill protect her human from every other dog

Fully VaccinatedSpayed4D TestedBrucellosis TestedMicrochippedFull RBU

Sadie has waited long enough. Could you be the one to finally take her home? Please get in touch today!

name: Daisy
description:
Daisy is a six month old female cross breed puppy who currently weighs around twelve kilograms and is expected to reach approximately twenty kilograms when fully grown.

She is fostered in a home in Bulgaria, where she has settled beautifully and is ready to travel to the United Kingdom once the right family is found.

Daisy is fully vaccinated, microchipped, neutered, clinically healthy, and will travel with an EU pet passport and all required documentation.

Daisy is an exceptionally calm, gentle, and easy-going puppy. Despite her young age, she has wonderful house manners and has adapted brilliantly to life in a home.

She is clean indoors, settles well, and happily stays home alone for a few hours without causing any damage or becoming distressed.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is a 5 year old male Spanish Hound Cross.

Milo is such a good boy, friendly, calm and clean.

Even cats are no issue for him! Milo would really like to have a loving home at last, someone who sees what a wonderful boy he is.

Milo is castrated, vaccinated, microchipped, blood tested, he has a passport and he can pack his bags if the right family appears.

He is currently in Spain but can travel abroad, the charity arranges all the paperwork and transport.

name: Trico
description:
Trico is a 4 year old male Gascon Saintongeois Cross.

After a really long wait at the pound, TRICO was recently released and he is proving to be the sweetest soul!

Currently in a foster home, his carer says he is a timid chap with people, but friendly with other dogs and super clean indoors.

Trico never gets into trouble! TRICO passions, so far, are food and he loves a scent too.

TRICO is such a lovely little man who needs a family of his own, a patient owner who can help him blossom.

TRICO he is castrated, vaccinated, microchipped, blood tested, he has a passport and he can pack his bags if the right family appears.

He is currently in Spain but can travel abroad, the charity arranges all the paperwork and transport.

name: Jesse
description:
Our extra special girl Jesse is approximately four years old and is a stunning little cross breed at the top end of small. Jesse weighs just nine kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets Jesse has been in our Cyprus shelter for just two weeks.

Jesse is visually stunning. Her tri colour coat is outstanding, and Jesse’s woeful eyes are a showstopper. With a charming and pretty face Jesse wins hearts instantly.

With a sublime demeanour Jesse and calm but happy disposition Jesse is a readymade adoption candidate who is so longing for her forever home.

Jesse could hardly be more deserving and has so much to offer. Such a low maintenance little sweetheart who loves human company and especially a lap and a cuddle.

Jesse walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Andres
description:
Meet Andres, a big, lovable 9 year old male crossbreed boy weighing around 45 kg, who’s ready to find his perfect match.

Andres absolutely adores people — and if you’re a woman, you might just become his favourite human instantly. He’s a friendly, easy going companion who fits beautifully into daily life.

Great with dogs and gentle with kidsHouse-trained and clean indoorsTravels well in the carWalks like a dream on the leashLoves water and bath timeCan stay home alone calmly (may bark if he hears unusual noises outside)Confident and relaxed in busy city environments — crowds and traffic don’t bother him at allPlease note: Andres cannot live with cats or small animals.

We’re looking for an experienced large-dog owner — ideally a woman — who can offer:

A home with a gardenAnother calm, confident dog companionUnderstanding of big dog needs and behaviour

Currently located outside of the UK, Andres is a wonderful, balanced dog who will bring loyalty, companionship, and a lot of love into the right home.

name: Nala
description:
Just look at that face! At only 1 year of age, Nala has already experienced being unwanted and ended up in the pound through no fault of her own.

Despite this, she hasn’t let it dim her spirit. Now, she is ready to find the security of a loving family who truly deserve her and can show her the stability she’s been missing.

Nala is a fun-loving, affectionate little girl who absolutely adores attention. She is very much a people dog, loves being around everyone, and will happily share a cuddle.

She is full of enthusiasm for life, and while she can get a little over-excited when she sees other dogs, it’s all friendly excitement and she’s making great progress with her training.

When it comes to outings, Nala loves going for a walk and exploring what the world has to offer.

She is learning her lead manners well, but this will need to continue in her new home with regular, consistent walks to help her build on the great foundation she’s already started.

This clever little pocket rocket is eager to learn and highly intelligent. She deserves so much more than kennel life; she deserves a sofa to curl up on, adventures with her family, and someone to love her forever.

She can potentially share her home with older children and will thrive with an understanding family willing to continue her training.

Could you be the person who changes Nala’s life? If this beautiful girl has caught your eye, we would love to hear from you.

name: Nala
description:
Nala is a 3 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross, who came into our care when her owner – local to us – was very tragically found dead in his flat.

There were two dogs there – Bear, who we rehomed a while back, and young Nala, whose mum was a typically loving Staffordshire Bull Terrier and her dad a Ridgeback x.

We’ve had quite a bit of interest in Nala but sadly nothing has quite worked out. Always very near misses though as there is much to love about Nala: she’s not huge energy; is a real love-bug, obedient and well-trained.

She loves the car. She is well socialised and is calm and comfortable walking in busy places – with just the occasional bark/minor reaction if another dog is in her face.

Shouty, unpredictable young children can also spook her (there’s no aggression; she just finds them a bit scary which is why we’ve specified no children in her new home).

We think she would do best either as an only dog or with a nice confident older male dog in a quiet, adult home with some bull-breed experience and without tons of visitors. (She’s very friendly/loving but can find a lot of comings and goings stressful).

She is fine to be left for a 2/3 hours once settled.

Nala has now been in a fabulous foster for some weeks and foster mum Amanda has nothing but praise for her – describing her as a very easy dog once she is settled.

Nala will be three in November. She is spayed, chipped, fully-vaccinated and treated for parasites. She weighs 30kg.

Nala is currently in Wittering nr Peterborough but can travel for the right home.

name: Champ
description:
Champ is a 1 year old male Patterdale Terrier Cross.

Cheeky Champ is looking for a terrier loving home that will be able to keep his active mind entertained. He is a young boy who will need continued training and guidance to help him grow into a well rounded gentleman.

Champ’s new adopters would benefit from a good understanding of terrier breeds, particularly Patterdales who often thrive on purpose and activity.

Champ loves learning and is looking for new owners who have the time and patience to give him plenty of mental and physical outlets and opportunities to practice behaviours natural to him.

He is affectionate and loves time with people but still shows lots of puppy and adolescent behaviours so will need a patient home to share their calm.

Champ copes well in his world and has especially enjoyed his trips to the park so would love someone with easy access to places he can explore and build skills slowly.

He quickly steals the heart of anyone he meets and will make a wonderful companion for anyone ready for a rewarding journey.

Champ can live in a ground floor flat as long as there is direct access to a private garden. He can live with dog savvy, older teenagers of 16+ who will give him space when needed and help with his training.

His new owner will be expected to continue his training and socialisation and will receive three free 1:1 sessions with our Mayhew Animal Behaviourist to help guide them.

Champ was found to have previous pelvic fractures after coming in to us which were already healing well so did not require surgery.

Champ now has an unusual gait but after a pain medication trial, it is believed he is comfortable and is not in need of meds at this time.

Due to these fractures, Champ may be more at risk of developing osteoarthritis later in life and may need medical management at any time.

Champ also has enamel hypoplasia on some teeth which means thinning or deficiency of the enamel layer. New adopters will need to be extra vigilant to dental hygiene.

Champ has been microchipped, neutered, will have received his first vaccination and is up to date with flea & worming treatment.

He has also been health checked and behaviourally assessed. Lastly, every dog adopted from us will go home with 4 weeks free pet insurance.

name: Frida
description:
Frida is a medium size very pretty crossbreed girl of just 4 years.

She is very loving, intelligent, affectionate and obedient, a real people dog. She can live alongside other dogs but would be happier I think as an only dog.

She is very well behaved on the lead, not reactive and is confident, well behaved and responsive on her walks. Frida is kennel clean and would make a great family friend for adventures and fun.

Frida would be okay to live with dog savvy children 12 years and over. Would consider families with younger children too.

She is neutered, inoculated, microchipped, etc and is available for meet and greets from our premises in Wistaston, Cheshire by appointment only.

name: Storm
description:
Storm is a 6 year old female Shepherd. She first entered rescue as a very young pup at just 4 months old, showing resilience from the very beginning.

She later found her first home when she was 10 months old, but sadly, her owner has since become very unwell, leading Storm to return to rescue and spend time in kennels.

Storm’s journey hasn’t been the smoothest, but she has always had rescue support behind her, ensuring she’s never left without care.

Recently, she was brought out of kennels and is now looking for her next forever home. She requires an experienced owner of Shepherds who understands her drive and characteristics.

Storm has a naturally high prey drive, which means she isn’t suitable to live with cats or other small furry animals. However, she has been living alongside four other dogs in her current setting, which shows she can enjoy the company of her own kind.

She would be best suited to a home with a male dog, though careful introductions would always be necessary.

When it comes to people, Storm is a complete star. She adores everyone she meets and is described as being excellent within the home environment.

Her only challenge is her enthusiasm on the lead, where she tends to pull due to her excitement about getting outdoors and exploring.

Storm is a bright, affectionate, and loyal Shepherd who needs the right home to thrive. With guidance from an experienced owner, she will continue to flourish, and her loving nature will shine through.

She truly deserves stability and a family who will commit to her for the rest of her life.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a 10 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a quirky girl with an inquisitive, endearing personality. She is particularly fond of soft toys.

Lola is a feral dog so she will not tolerate being touched or walked, however, she happily lived in a home for several years and does enjoy her home comforts.

Lola has been spending some time in foster where she has been the star guest – she is quiet, clean and non-destructive.

When Lola arrived with us she was extremely overweight, she is now at a healthy weight but we have discovered her history of sweet treats has resulted in her being rather fussy when it comes to eating regular dog food!

Lola has had some teeth removed and will require a soft diet. Her tongue does now stick out to the side of her mouth but we feel this just adds to her charm!

Lola is currently on medication for urinary incontinence which has been working wonders and she no longer has any accidents.

Lola does get along well with other dogs but we do feel she would be best suited to being the only dog in the home. She has previously lived with cats without any issues. Lola needs a calm, quiet household with a secure garden.

name: Basil
description:
Meet Basil, a 2 year old male Labrador Retriever Cross who’s the very definition of joy on four paws.

Saved from a kill shelter in July 2025, Basil went from heartbreak to happiness—and he’s never looked back.

2 years old – the happiest boy in the world

His joy is contagious – always smiling and wagging his tail

Fantastic with everyone – people, dogs, life itself

The heart of our pension – he lights up every room

If there’s one word to describe Basil, it’slight.His happiness is contagious, his tail never stops wagging, and his smile? It can turn even the darkest day into sunshine.

He is the soul of our pension, the dog who lifts every spirit, spreads warmth, and reminds us why we rescue.

Yet, for all the joy he gives, Basil has never had someone to call his own. When he was behind bars in the kill shelter, his sadness broke all our hearts—but the moment he was freed, he never got his distant parents.

No one stepped forward to be his sponsor, his protector, the one to keep him safe until adoption.

Now, we hope someone will see him,really see him, and give him the forever home he so deeply deserves. Because if there was ever a dog who could make a family happier, brighter, and more full of love—it’s Basil.

Basil has given so much love without asking for anything in return. Now it’s his turn. If you’re looking for a dog who will fill your life with joy, laughter, and unconditional love, Basil is waiting for you.

name: Noodle
description:
Meet Noodle, a 3 year old male Belgian Malinois Cross — the dog who waited for a goodbye that never came.

Noodle didn’t come from the streets. He wasn’t born unwanted. He had a home, a person, and a quiet little life. An elderly man who he followed everywhere, who he trusted completely, who he believed would never leave him.

And then, one day, that man took him to a pound. No words. No glance back. Just walked away.

We can only imagine Noodle’s confusion — how he must have pulled toward the door, waiting for the sound of familiar footsteps, for the voice that would tell him it was all a mistake. But no one came.

Days turned into weeks. His world went silent. When we found him in that kill shelter, he was still waiting — still watching the door, still believing.

And when the gate finally opened, he wagged his tail. Not in anger, not in fear — but in forgiveness. He didn’t belong there. You could see it instantly.

Personality: Intelligent, loyal, affectionate, and forgiving

He was different — too gentle, too loving, too full of light for that kind of place. Now, safe with us, Noodle shines again.

He’s a beautiful, smart, and sensitive boy who loves people with a devotion that breaks your heart a little because you know how deeply he’s been hurt. He leans into every touch.

He looks at you like you’re his whole world. And maybe, for him, you would be.

Noodle lost everything once — his home, his person, his place in the world. But he never lost his hope. If you can give this brave, forgiving boy the forever love he’s still waiting for, please message us. Noodle’s heart is ready to belong again!

name: Bernie
description:
Bernie is a 2 month old male mixed breed puppy currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

He is an adorable little boy full of confidence, curiosity and love.

He enjoys everyone he meets and is wonderful with dogs, cats and children.

Bernie is expected to grow into a small/medium-sized adult and is looking for a family ready to guide him through puppyhood with plenty of love, patience and positive training.

name: Penny
description:
Penny is a 6.5-month-old female Cross-Breed. She is a small girl who weighs around 7 kilos and is currently in foster care in Nottingham. Penny came from Romania, where she had been living on the streets before being rescued by a kind vet.

Penny has now been living in Nottingham for approximately three months. She is described as a shy and sweet girl who can be nervous at first when faced with new situations.

With time, patience, and the right environment, she can continue building her confidence.

Penny would benefit from living with a confident, friendly, and playful dog or dogs. She can live with other dogs, and having canine company could provide her with reassurance as she continues to settle and become more comfortable in her surroundings.

She has not been cat tested, so her reaction to cats is currently unknown. Penny can live with older children, giving her the opportunity to become part of a family that understands she may initially need some time and space to feel comfortable.

Her lead training is currently in progress, so her new family will need to continue helping her develop her skills when out and about.

Her toilet training is also still progressing, making continued patience and consistency an important part of helping her settle into her new home.

Penny can be left alone for short periods. As a young dog who is still developing her confidence and learning about life in a home, she will benefit from people who are willing to support her progress.

Now settled in Nottingham after approximately three months in foster care, Penny is ready to find a loving forever home.

Her sweet nature and ability to live with dogs make her a lovely prospect for a family that can give her the patience, companionship, and encouragement she needs to flourish.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie is a female Pointer Cross approximately 2 years old and 20 kilos and the amazing mum of 8 puppies.

At the end of May bonie was found in the middle of a road feeding 3 puppies. One of our amazing volunteer fosterers offered to get her and found a further 5 puppies!!

Our lovely Foster mum and her son, are now looking after them all at her home.

Bonnie has shown her true loving, kind and gentle self, she happily plays with the other dogs but is equally content to take a nap in a quiet area.

She loves nothing more than a million tummy tickles, and then maybe even more tickles. She is a tiny bit shy but that’s expected, in no time at all she trusts.

She also lives with cats, there is no aggression, there are hens there too. Happy to share food and has no resource guarding.

Her lead walking is fine , this will need further training and practice, she is after all a Pointer cross, any recall training will require time.

Bonnie sleeps quietly through the night, she is clean over night too. Appears to travel quietly in a car with some uncertainty.

Bonnie’s ideal home is a family with people around quite a bit, although she is used to being left for a number of hours.

We believe her confidence in the big wide world will benefit from another canine companion and a secured lovely garden, she loves the outside in the warm sun.

Above all a family that will continue with her training, shower her in love, kindness and offer her the exercise and stimulation her breed needs.

Please, please, share Bonnie’s story, she can only stay with the foster lady until August , and we don’t want to have take her to kennels in Cyprus after her life with a family.

name: Archie
description:
Meet Archie — a beautiful 2 year old young male Pointer cross with a gentle heart and so much potential. Archie carries the familiar story of many hunting dogs we see. Too gentle to hunt and so abandoned

At just 2 years old, he already shows the emotional scars of a dog who likely learned that the world could be unpredictable and frightening. Sudden movements and loud noises still startle him. New people can feel overwhelming.

So when Archie feels unsure, he does what many sensitive dogs do

But what makes Archie so special is this:

He is trying. Every single day, he gets a little braver. Every single day, he chooses trust a little more.

And when he feels safe enough, you get a glimpse of the real Archie.

A playful boy who enjoys toys. A sweet soul who wants connection. A young dog who is slowly discovering that life can actually be good.

Archie is wonderful with other dogs and would especially benefit from a happy, confident dog companion who can help guide him and show him that the world isn’t so scary after all.

He could potentially live as an only dog, but we truly believe another stable dog would help him flourish

He may also suit a home with dog-savvy children aged 12+ who understand calm, respectful interactions.

Archie doesn’t need someone to “fix” him. He simply needs someone willing to say:

“You are safe now. Take all the time you need.”

And once Archie fully believes that… we think he is going to be extraordinary.

Could you be the person who helps Archie write the next chapter of his story?

name: Yochan
description:
Meet Yochan — a beautiful 2 year old, male Pointer cross, 18 Kilos, whose journey is a story of courage, trust, and quiet transformation.

When Yochan first came to us, he wouldn’t approach people at all. He kept his distance, unsure, guarded, and not ready to trust.

Because look at him now. Now, Yochan comes running for hugs.

Yes – the same dog who once stayed far away now chooses human connection. He actively seeks affection and will quietly sit beside you, patiently waiting to be stroked, soaking in every gentle touch.

His progress has been beautiful to witness.

Yochan is a gentle soul with a soft heart. He has medium energy, enjoys companionship, and has a calm sweetness about him that makes people fall in love once they truly see him.

He is good with other dogs and could happily live as an only dog, but if he had a canine companion, a confident female dog would likely suit him best.

We do expect that moving into a home may feel overwhelming at first. Like many sensitive rescue dogs, Yochan may initially become shy or partially shut down in a new environment.

We already know what Yochan is capable of. We have already seen him bloom. We have already seen fear turn into trust. Distance turn into affection. Caution turn into love.

Because the dog waiting underneath that initial shyness is incredible.

The real Yochan is loving, gentle, affectionate, and deeply loyal.

“Take your time. I’m not going anywhere.”

And for a dog like Yochan, those words can change everything.

name: Marco
description:
Meet Marco — a beautiful 2 year old hound mix, 16.5 kilos with soulful eyes and a heart that is still learning that it is safe to love.

Some dogs arrive in rescue carrying invisible scars. Marco is likely one of those dogs.

As a hound, he was probably expected to be something he simply wasn’t meant to be—a hunting dog. But not every hunting breed is born for that life, and sadly, the gentle ones, like Marco often get left behind.

Marco shows many of the familiar signs of an abandoned hunting dog: a little fear, some uncertainty, and a cautious way of moving through the world… as if life has taught him to be careful.

But despite this , something beautiful shines through. Marco hasn’t given up on people. He still wants to trust and still wants to be loved.

This sweet boy loves to sniff and explore the world through his nose, just as hounds do. Watching him follow a scent is watching him do what comes naturally to him.

For Marco, walks aren’t about distance or speed—they’re about discovery, smells, and freedom. A long lead and safe adventures would make him incredibly happy.

Marco is wonderful with other dogs and truly benefits from their company. We believe he would thrive with a happy, confident dog friend who can help show him that life doesn’t always have to feel scary.

The kind of bond you build with a rescue dog like Marco is never instant—but it is profound. Because when a cautious dog finally chooses to trust you, it means everything and you will see the dog he was always meant to be….. Loving. Loyal. Gentle. Devoted.

Marco is looking for a calm, understanding home with children over 10, patient humans, and hearts big enough to let him bloom in his own time. Marco doesn’t need saving anymore. He needs belonging.

name: Rainbow
description:
Rainbow is one of those dogs who makes you stop and think. At just 18 months old, Rainbow has already learned so much.

She is house trained, crate trained, comfortable being left alone, excellent in the car, and comfortable with a harness and lead. She is used to busy households and office life, and is happy around TV, music, meetings and everyday household noise.

She is wonderful with people, including men and women, good with children, good with birds, and fantastic at the vets. And she’s a clever girl too!

SitHigh fiveStayHeelTurn“Safety”“Chill” / place

She is a beautifully trained young dog who has already learned how to live alongside her people and fit into everyday life.

And then there’s Rainbow herself. She is affectionate, funny, intelligent and full of character.

Her absolute favourite thing in the world? Getting wet! Rainbow LOVES lying in water and is perfectly happy joining you in the shower for some peanut butter bribery!

She also has very refined culinary tastes: carrots, cucumbers, cheese. Honestly, she’s a girl who knows what she likes!

Rainbow would love a home where her size and breed type are understood and appreciated. Experience with large breeds, shepherds or livestock guardian-type dogs would be advantageous.

A secure gardenAn active but balanced lifestyleContinued positive training and engagementSomeone who understands the independence and instincts that can come with guardian breedsA family committed to making her a permanent part of their lives

She is fully vaccinated, fully health checked, has had blood tests, and is spayed.

name: Max
description:
Max is a strikingly handsome, loyal and intelligent boy who is ready for his new life. At approximately 18 months old and 30 kilos, Max is a large male German Shepherd Cross with a gentle heart and a playful spirit.

Max is the kind of dog who makes an impression the moment you meet him, confident, affectionate, and beautifully connected to his people.

Great with other dogs, social, friendly and easygoingVery loyal and smart, bonds deeply and learns quicklyLoves being brushed, fussed, and played withWalks beautifully on a leadExcellent at the vets, calm and cooperativeNo reaction to the clinic’s mascot catPlays happily with our 14-year-old work experience studentHas interacted with small dogs and younger children with no issues

Healthy, fully vaccinated and neutered. And truly, he has the best set of pearly white teeth we’ve ever seen.

Max is an all-around super boy who will thrive with:

An active family with experience of large breedsSomeone home oftenChildren aged 10+ due to his sizeA home that values companionship, routine, and fun

Max cannot live with cats, but he can live with other dogs.

name: Coco
description:
Coco is a gorgeous 5 month old cross breed puppy. Mum was a small dog however we do not know who Dad was. Puppies were born in rescue in Spain and as Mum was surrendered to the shelter Mum can be seen with babies after birth.

Please ask for the photos. They are presently at the shelter in Spain and will travel directly to their adopters new homes. We also have video footage we can send via WhatsApp to the rescue number attached to this advert.

Coco will probably be a medium sized dog and Mum was very much like a Jack Russell so likely to be full of personality.

He is a happy playful boy that will benefit from an active family life with lots of playing and lovely family walks. Thanks to the dedication of caring volunteers, Coco will blossom as he waits for his own family.

There were six puppies in the litter and three have already been rehomed leaving Coco and two sisters still waiting for their homes. It would be really beneficial to them not to have to wait a lot longer.

Coco will have had all his vaccinations and his microchip but still too young for neutering. He will travel with his EU passport with his chip registered in the passport.

We believe he is just the right addition for a family looking for a young dog to complete the family.

Please in the first instance send us some information regarding your type of home, your secured garden space and your working patterns. Ensure everyone in the home is in agreement for adopting a pet.

Once we have completed a video call home check you fund the rest of your dogs costs and we co-ordinate the adoption and transport to your home.

name: Blake
description:
Gorgeous Blake is a friendly, large and sometimes timid, laid-back young man aged just two and a half years old. He has a soft, short, tan and white coat and attractive facial markings.

As typical of the breed, Blake is a Spanish Mastin Cross. He is calm and a serious boy.

Blake likes other dogs and can be tested for cats. He is a wonderful boy who just adores people once he gets to know them.

We are looking for a family who prefer bigger dogs, with an interest in the outdoors and an adequate garden size for him, who may have another friendly dog for play. He can be an only dog if his family work from home, and children should be over 12 years old due to his size.

Gets on well with all dogs, likes people, has a gentle, friendly manner about him, and is laid-back.

Blake is currently in Spain and can travel to the UK in mid-September.

name: Hera
description:
The very beautiful and incredibly affectionate Hera is waiting for her forever home…

Hera is a larger Labrador mix girl (standing about 80cm) with a blonde, soft, short coat. She was found abandoned a few months ago, she came into our care and has lapped up all the attention she can get ever since.

Hera is approximately 2 years old and, once introduced, gets on with all her kennel mates. She can be a slow burner though and a bit barky to begin with but after that it’s play time.

Hera doesn’t like cats, but she loves her walks and is a good (but can be a strong) girl on the lead. She is like a big puppy!

Hera is spayed, up to date with her vaccinations and has her passport in place so could travel to the right family, her blood tests were all clear.

We are looking for a family with no cats and children over 12 years because she jumps up with excitement, which will subside once she’s being trained in her new home.

Another friendly playful dog would be good for her too and a large enough garden for her to run around.

Living with dogs : yesLiving with cats : noLiving with children : yes over 12NEEDS to live with another dog MaybeLocated in Spain

name: Titan
description:
Titan is a large Spanish Mastiff, 6 years old.

Titan is a a very handsome Spanish Mastiff, as you would expect for his breed, he’s quite a big lads and weighs 45kg. He was purchased as a puppy to guard a flock of sheep, which is very typical of for his breed in the north of Spain.

But the sheep moved on and they no longer had a use for Titan. So, the poor lad was left chained up in a kennel behind his owners house.

Thankfully a very kind group of volunteers spotted him and brought him food and water, and started to take him for walks out in the village so that he wouldn’t be stuck tied up all day and now thankfully he’s in a shelter with a rescue we work very closely with while he awaits a family of his own.

Dogs like Titan are absolutely amazing, they have seen the worst of humans but still come out the other side of it as happy dogs.

He’s a typical gentle giant, and gets along well with everyone; dogs, cats, farm animals and children. The ladies at his shelter say he is the kindest and most balanced dog there and that he has the most spectacular temperament.

Titan can slot into most homes because of his wonderful personality. He can live with children, as an only dog or with other dogs.

name: Lenny
description:
Lenny is a 4-year-old small sized American Bulldog cross.

Lenny is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Lenny is a 4-year-old American Bulldog cross with a sweet and gentle nature. Although a little unsure when meeting new people, once he feels safe, he blossoms into a playful, affectionate boy who loves nothing more than a good toy session!

If you are happy to throw a squeaky toy for him all day long then you will very quickly make a new best friend. He really is a gem with so much potential.

Lenny is crate trained and finds comfort in having a safe space of his own. He’s also house trained and keeps his environment clean, making him a joy to have around the home.

He travels well in the car, making him a great buddy for road trips or vet visits without the stress, in fact he seems to get more excited about being In the car than the actual walk!

He’s shown himself to be neutral and polite with other dogs when out and about on a walk, and seems disinterested in cats, but would be best as the only pet in the home,

Lenny can be a little pushy in certain situations, particularly when asked to do something he’s unsure about – a trait that’s not unusual for his breed.

Because of this, a confident, calm owner would really help him thrive. Previous experience with American Bulldogs or similar breeds would be helpful, though it isn’t essential.

He would benefit from multiple meet & greets to help build a strong bond before going home, and he’s currently available for either adoption or temporary foster.

With all the change he’s experienced lately, he’s bound to be a little confused and would really flourish in a stable, loving environment where he can feel safe and settled again.

Lenny is neutered, vaccinated, flea and wormed.

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a 2-year-old Belgian Malinois Cross American bulldog.

Bear is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Bear, our 2-year-old heartbreaker, struts his stuff on the leash like a pro, gives paw like a true gentleman, and even tucks himself in at night! We suspect he’s part Malinois, part bull breed, and all mischief.

Sure, he can jump a 6ft obstacle and redecorate with the best of them, but hey, who doesn’t love a bit of chaos?

Bear’s health is top-notch, and his intelligence is off the chats—now if only we could convince him to use it for good!

Bear is fine with other dogs when out and about but we would not rehome him with another dog in the home. He will benefit from still being socialised with other dogs outside the home.

He is best suited to a home with older children only, where he can enjoy structure, calm, and consistency.

Someone with breed experience is important as Bear is a high energy dog who is very intelligent – his new owner will need to be able to give him enough physical and mental stimulation and in reward you will have an amazing dog!

Bear is house trained, crate trained and good with everyone he meets

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Hooch
description:
Hooch is a 1-year-old male Belgian Malinois with a huge heart and an even bigger love for fun.

When he first arrived, Hooch was a little unsure around new people, but it didn’t take long for his true personality to shine through.

He’s an affectionate, friendly boy who loves making new friends—especially if his favourite toy is part of the introduction!

As a typical Belgian Malinois, Hooch is a high-energy dog who will thrive in an active home. He’ll need plenty of exercise and mental stimulation both indoors and outdoors. Activities like agility, scentwork/trailing, or flyball would suit him perfectly.

Hooch can live with older children and could potentially live with another dog following multiple successful meets. He has previously lived with another dog with no issues.

This playful lad adores his toys—fetch is his absolute favourite—so a good supply of toys is a must for his new home!

Hooch is currently struggling in kennels and really deserves to find his forever home soon. If you’re looking for a loyal, fun-loving, and affectionate best friend, please apply below to meet Hooch. He’s ready to brighten someone’s life.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Ben
description:
Ben is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He comes across as a gentle giant, weighing around 35kg, yet he’s surprisingly easy to handle on the lead.

Ben has a reputation for being exceptional with his human family, and he mixes well with other dogs while even tolerating cats with calm patience.

Ben is a much-loved dog who previously lived on the square in North Macedonia, where he was cared for by the local community.

His life changed when new business owners moved in and no longer wanted him around, leading to his rescue and placement in foster care. Despite the upheaval, his affectionate nature has remained unwavering.

Ben’s foster carer speaks incredibly highly of him, describing him as loving, house-trained, and always eager for a good walk. He has settled well into life in the UK, showing the same charm and warmth that made him popular back home.

Anyone welcoming him into their home would be gaining a loyal, sweet-natured companion.

name: Nicol
description:
Nicol – A Heart Full of Love and a Fountain of Energy

Nicol is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Expected arrival 19 December.

Meet Nicol, a 2–3-year-old Labrador or cross girl, medium-to-upper-medium size. She’s a radiant, loving whirlwind of joy and energy — the kind of dog who fills a room with life and love just by walking into it. Trustful, affectionate, and endlessly playful, Nicol is pure sunshine in motion.

HighlightsSIZE: Medium/upper-medium (53–55 cm shoulder height / 20 kg)SPAYED: YesCHARACTER HIGHLIGHTS: Loving • Playful • High-energy • Smart • LoyalDOGS: Friendly but can be too pushy for calm or older dogs, better suits as the only dog or with young playful large maleCATS: Not testedCHILDREN: Best with confident, gentle children 10+ due to her lively energy

Rescue StorySome stories leave even the strongest hearts trembling — and Nicol’s is one of them.One day, a man appeared at the gates of a small shelter, holding Nicol on a piece of rope. He asked them to take her in, but the shelter was already full — there was simply no space. When told no, he turned away in frustration and headed towards the railway tracks, muttering that he would throw her under a train.

The volunteers ran after him and managed to save her just in time. From that moment on, Nicol became one of the most affectionate dogs they’ve ever known, as if she understood that kindness had just given her another chance at life.

Since then, Nicol has lived in foster care, and her gratitude shines in everything she does — in her wagging tail, her warm hugs, and her endless eagerness to please.

More About NicolNicol is a volcano of joy — a dog who greets every day as if it’s the best one ever. She adores her humans, seeking affection, hugs, and kisses. She’s incredibly smart and quick to learn, especially when treats and praise are involved.

Playtime is her favourite part of the day — she loves running, chasing toys, and wrestling playfully with other dogs. However, her enthusiasm can be a bit much for calmer or older dogs, so she would thrive either as the only dog in the home (with plenty of doggy playdates) or with a confident, playful male dog who matches her energy.

She lives in a home environment, is fully housetrained, and walks well on the lead, though can sometimes pull of excitement. Nicol’s joy, warmth, and love for people make her a truly special soul — one who deserves the best life after all she’s been through.

Ideal FamilyNicol would be perfect for an active family or individual who enjoys adventures, outdoor walks, and laughter-filled days. A secure garden is a must, as she loves to run and play. She’ll thrive in a home where someone is around most of the time and where her affectionate, energetic personality is embraced and celebrated.

Nicol was nearly lost forever, but kindness gave her a second chance. Now she’s ready to give all her love — and she has plenty of it to give. If you’re looking for a loyal, joyful, and deeply affectionate companion who will fill your life with laughter, hugs, and devotion, Nicol is waiting with open paws.

Health InformationNicol is fully healthy. Spayed, vaccinated, and microchipped.All dogs are C.Brucella tested before travel (owners receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Alaya
description:
Alaya – The Gentle Soul Who Believes in Love

Alaya is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Arrival in the UK expected 19 December.

Alaya is a beautiful upper-medium/large girl, around 4 years old. Her eyes tell a story of pain, hope, and endless loyalty. Despite all she has been through, Alaya remains one of those rare dogs whose faith in humans never broke.

Rescue StoryWhen the war tore through Ukraine, Alaya’s life was turned upside down. Her owner was called to the frontline and, desperate to keep her safe, placed her in temporary care. Sadly, the conditions were dreadful, she lived in a kennel near garages. When her rescuer reached out to help, she was found frightened and confused — someone had even used her for cruel “target practice” with an air gun.

About AlayaEven after everything, Alaya’s heart remains full of love. She’s gentle, quiet, and deeply affectionate — a dog who melts into cuddles and leans into her person with trust and longing. She can be little shy in a new environment, but once she feels safe, she shows her warm and loyal personality, following her person everywhere with gratitude in her eyes.

She is selective with dogs and prefers to be the only pet. Alaya is housetrained, polite indoors, and walks on a lead.

Ideal FamilyAlaya will thrive in a calm, loving home where she can finally exhale and enjoy peace. She’s best as an only dog and would suit a family or person with a gentle nature, perhaps with older children who understand that kindness and patience mean the world to her. A garden and quiet walks would make her happiest — she treasures the simple joys of life she once lost.

Alaya’s story is one of heartbreak turned into hope. Despite the cruelty she suffered, she still greets people with soft eyes and a wagging tail. Whoever opens their heart to her will gain an incredibly loyal, loving companion who will give back every ounce of kindness tenfold.

Health InformationAlaya is fully healthy. The pellets after shooting were later removed and healed. Spayed. Has all core vaccines done and is microchipped. C.Brucella tested before travel (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support and 4 weeks free insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Lord
description:
Lord – The Wise Young Gentleman With a Noble Heart

Lord is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Expected arrival: 19 December.

Meet Lord – a 7-month-old lower-medium boy, expected to grow a little more, whose gentle dignity and natural intelligence make him stand out from the very first moment.

He may be young, but he carries himself with a calm, thoughtful presence that feels far beyond his age. A tender soul with a noble heart, Lord is ready to bring warmth, loyalty, and quiet wisdom into a family of his own.

He will be lower-medium in size (below the knee) when fully grown.

Rescue StoryLord and his two sisters, Nusha and Lisa, were found as tiny pups at summer houses settlement— alone, unwanted, and surviving only thanks to sheer luck and their bond with one another. Someone had left them behind, and like countless dogs in Ukraine, they slipped through the cracks of people’s lives. A volunteer discovered them just in time and brought them to safety, giving these three youngsters a chance to grow up surrounded by kindness instead of danger.

More About LordLord is, in every sense, a remarkable puppy. Despite his age, he carries himself with a gentle maturity — wise, calm, and incredibly easy to teach. He understands new commands instantly, observes before acting, and behaves at home like he’s already lived there for years.

His foster family says:“This is the perfect dog. Despite being so young, he is unbelievably wise and balanced. You can feel a childlike nobility in him. With the right family, he will grow into a true wonder-dog.”

He loves humans deeply, adores other dogs, and will thrive with a friendly canine buddy. Outdoors he enjoys playtime; indoors he is peaceful, polite and affectionate.

Ideal FamilyLord will thrive in a loving home that appreciates a sensitive, intelligent companion who learns fast and wants to please. He would enjoy an active lifestyle with people who value both playtime and calm companionship. Another friendly dog in the home would make him truly happy, giving him a steady companion and helping him settle faster. Gentle children 8+ would suit him well.

Lord is truly special — wise, loving, and beautifully gentle. Whoever adopts him will gain a devoted friend with a heart full of quiet loyalty.

Health InformationLord is fully healthy. Neutered. Has all core vaccines done and is microchipped. All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Sunny
description:
Our extra special boy Sunny is approximately three years old and an interesting cross breed just at the very bottom end of medium.

Sunny weighs just twelve kilos and measures thirteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets Sunny has been in our Cyprus shelter for three months.

Our shelter manager describes Sunny as bubbly, energetic and fun loving. He is such an endearing little chap with a happy disposition that translates into an enthusiasm for life.

Everyone agrees that Sunny lights up the room and his enquiring nature is apparent. He enjoys watching everything that’s going on around him and so savours a cuddle or a lap.

Sunny has an appearance that is exemplary. His soft brown coat is gorgeous, and his eyes are bright along with his tail held high. Just a stunning little dog who so deserves his forever home with a loving family. Sunny has so much to offer.

Sunny walks nicely on his lead and enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Millie
description:
Meet Milly – A Little Bundle of Joy Looking for Her Forever Home!

Size: Small – currently around 5kg and expected to grow into a larger small-sized dog

Health: Fully vaccinated and comes with her pet passport. Not yet spayed due to her age; spaying will be a condition of her adoption contract.

Introducing Milly! If you’re looking for a little dog with a huge personality, then look no further than our gorgeous Milly! Milly is an absolutely delightful, funny and beautiful little girl who seems to have been born with a smile on her face.

She is full of joy, full of fun and has a wonderful way of making everyone she meets fall in love with her. Milly was found abandoned when she was just a few weeks old.

She was so tiny that she wasn’t even able to eat independently, so she had a very vulnerable start to life. Thankfully, she was rescued and given the care she needed to grow into the happy, confident little character she is today.

A Little Social Butterfly Milly is a wonderfully happy and sociable puppy who loves everyone.

She has lived with other dogs, including an adult male and two puppies, and gets along brilliantly with them.

She is also familiar with cats. In fact, until she was around two months old, Milly lived indoors with 11 cats, so she has had plenty of feline company!

And children? She absolutely loves them! Milly really is a little people-loving sweetheart. She enjoys company, attention and being part of whatever is going on around her.

What Will Milly Need? Like any young puppy, Milly still has a little learning to do as she prepares for life in her forever home.

Toilet training: She will need some continued help and patience with housetraining.

Lead walking: She has done a little lead work, but this will need to continue as she grows in confidence and experience.

Settling into home life: She will need time to learn the routines and expectations of her new family.

Training and socialisation: She is still a young puppy, so ongoing positive training, guidance and plenty of appropriate experiences will be important.

Milly is a lovely, sociable little girl who we think could suit a wide variety of homes, provided her family has the time and commitment to raise a young dog.

A Note About Milly’s Health A little while ago, Milly’s carer noticed that she seemed to be walking slightly unusually on her back legs.

She was taken for X-rays, which thankfully came back perfectly normal. A specialist explained that the issue was related to her growth.

She was given joint supplements (chondroprotectors) and calcium, and we’re pleased to say that she has been doing much better.

We want to be open about her history so that her new family is fully aware of her background.

Could You Be Milly’s Forever Family? Milly is such a happy little soul. She has come a long way from the tiny, abandoned puppy who couldn’t even feed herself, and now she is ready to start the next chapter of her life.

She is funny, affectionate, sociable and full of character. At around 5kg already, she is expected to remain a small dog, although likely to be at the larger end of the small-size category.

She would love a family who will enjoy her playful puppy antics, include her in family life and give her all the love, patience and guidance she needs to grow into a wonderful adult dog. Milly has so much happiness to share.

All she needs now is someone to share it with! Interested in Adopting Milly? Milly is waiting at Saving and Rehoming Strays SCIO in Ayr, Scotland.

If you think you could offer her the home she deserves, please visit: www.savingandrehomingstrays.org A home check and adoption donation apply.

Applicants must be able to travel to Ayr for a meet and greet and, if successful, collection. Milly is not yet old enough to be spayed.

Her spay will therefore be a condition of her adoption contract and must be completed when she is old enough. Please tell us as much as you can about the home you could offer her when applying.

name: Joy
description:
Meet Joy – A Little Girl with a BIG Personality!

Size: Small – approximately Jack Russell size

Health: Spayed, fully vaccinated and comes with her pet passport.

Introducing Joy! Well, where do we start with this gorgeous girl? Amazing, amazing, amazing!

Meet Joy, a beautiful little brown girl with the funniest ears and a personality to match. Her name really does say it all because she is an absolute joy to be around!

Joy is a confident, happy little dog who loves people and enjoys being part of family life. She has a lovely outgoing personality and isn’t afraid to show it.

She is affectionate, friendly and full of character, and we think she is going to make someone a very special companion.

A Little Social Butterfly Joy has already experienced life in a home environment, having previously spent time in foster care before coming into our rescue.

She is great with her canine friends and could happily share her home with another suitable dog. She has also lived with children while in foster care, so she is accustomed to family life and the hustle and bustle that can come with it.

Joy is not a particularly barky little dog, which is another lovely bonus! We haven’t assessed her with cats, so we cannot say how she would be around them.

Out and About Joy has done some lead work and has made a good start, but she’ll need some further training as she adjusts to life in a permanent family home.

With patience, encouragement and consistency, she’ll have the opportunity to build on what she’s already learned. She is a small dog, around Jack Russell size, but she certainly doesn’t lack confidence or personality!

Joy is a lovely, adaptable little girl who we think could suit lots of different types of homes. She could potentially live with or without another dog, provided introductions are positive and any existing dog is a suitable match. We would love to find her a family who will:

Enjoy taking her out on walks and adventures.

Give her plenty of love, attention and companionship.

Continue to encourage her and help her develop her skills.

Appreciate all the fun and character that comes with this little girl! Joy has already shown us what a wonderful little dog she is.

She has experience of living in a home, gets along beautifully with other dogs, enjoys people and has a lovely confident nature. Honestly, she really is a little gem – and those ears are just the icing on the cake!

Could Joy Be Your Perfect Match? Joy is ready to leave rescue life behind and find a family to call her own. She has so much to offer and we think someone is going to be incredibly lucky to welcome her into their life.

If you think Joy could be the little girl you’ve been looking for, please visit: www.savingandrehomingstrays.org Joy is currently at Saving and Rehoming Strays SCIO in Ayr, Scotland.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Applicants must be able to travel to Ayr for a meet and greet and, if successful, collection.

Joy is spayed, fully vaccinated and has her pet passport. Could you be the lucky person who gets to make this lovely little girl’s next chapter a happy one?

name: Penny
description:
Say hello to Penny, a 5 year old beautiful Akita girl who is looking for a fresh start in a new home. Penny originally arrived as a stray after being found wandering and never claimed, but her luck changed when she was offered a rescue space.

Now, she is ready to find the security of a loving family who truly deserve her.

When Penny first arrived, she was very nervous and head-shy. However, she has improved in confidence quickly and is showing what a wonderful girl she can be.

She recently spent a couple of nights in a home where she was a bit unsettled, showing us that she doesn’t take to new environments like a duck to water.

Because of this, she will need a patient family who is happy to work with her, help her unpack her baggage, and give her the time she needs to fully relax and settle in.
